description: Luw.ai Magic Wand AI: change only a masked area of an image. Give a prompt to add/replace what's there, remove=true to erase it, or material_image to re-surface it (e.g. new flooring or wall tiles). The mask is a black-and-white image the same size as the input; white marks the area to change. Get masks from luw_segment. Costs 1 credit.

enhance_prompt.description: Let Luw.ai's prompt enhancer expand a short prompt.

image.description: Image to edit (https:// URL, local file path, or data: URI).

keep_structure.description: Preserve the masked area's geometry/lines while changing its look (structure-guided fill).

mask_image.description: Black/white mask, white = area to change (https:// URL, local file path, or data: URI).

material_image.description: Material/texture to apply to the masked area (https:// URL, local file path, or data: URI); luw_list_options kind="materials" has a ready-made catalog.

prompt.description: What to put in the masked area.

remove.description: Remove whatever is in the masked area.

name: luw_magic_wand
title: Masked edit: replace, remove, change material (Magic Wand AI)
